confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are bounded estimates from dated or mixed-quality sources: reviews, expat guides and one 2026 averaged guide in GBP. No source gave a current cappuccino price, so coffee is inferred from reported iced coffee at about 1.80 USD in Western-style cafes. Cocktail and wine are derived from the local beer relationship (cocktail about 3 to 4 times draft beer, wine above beer), because direct data was weak. Beach-strip bars likely charge more than the local venues the sources describe. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the Sihanoukville context, not from live booking pages or current listings. The FX observation is the most recent RBA figure I could confirm from search results (20 March 2026), and I could not verify a later RBA observation, so it may be stale relative to the 2026-10-16 generation date.
comparable_city_reasoning: Cambodian beach-resort pricing benchmarked on Sihanoukville-specific reviews and cost-of-living guides. Cocktail and wine are derived from the beer anchor. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for a Cambodian beach-resort town, not drawn from listings.
